mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 46 degrees and clear near the Verona Public Library. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Public Works Department is hard at work maintaining our streets and utilities. You can keep up with their progress and other city developments by subscribing to the digital newsletter on the city website.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with Live Music at Paddy Mac's today, and Yoga at Insight Wellness today as well. Plus, join us for Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory tomorrow or the ART House 360 events tomorrow.
In a report regarding service calls from November 1 to 15, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue resulted in an O W I arrest.
Today's delicious flavor is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. Please note that Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM.
